caption_en:
The judge's name is the part that never made the headlines. ⚖️

30 Dec 2010: Tel Aviv District Court convicts Israel's former president Moshe Katsav of rape and other sexual offences. The judge leading the three-judge panel: George Karra, an Arab Christian born in Jaffa.
22 Mar 2011: seven years in prison. Katsav appeals; the Supreme Court panel includes Justice Salim Joubran, also an Arab citizen. 10 Nov 2011: appeal rejected, unanimously. 7 Dec 2011: Katsav enters prison (released Dec 2016).
In 2017 Judge Karra joined Israel's Supreme Court; he retired in 2022 at 70.

No single case proves equality: Israel's civil service target for Arab staff is just 10%, unchanged since 2008, while Arabs are about 20% of the workforce (INSS).

Could this happen in your country? Tell me below.

Sources: Al Jazeera (2010, 2011); Globes (2010); Supreme Court of Israel ruling (10 Nov 2011); Israel Hayom and JNS (2022); INSS.
Photos (Wikimedia Commons): Fallaner (CC BY-SA 4.0); israeltourism (CC BY 2.0); Amos Ben Gershom, GPO (CC BY-SA 3.0); Boris Carmi, NLI (CC BY 4.0). AI voice.
caption_he:
שופט ערבי אחד. נשיא לשעבר אחד בכלא.
30 בדצמבר 2010: בית המשפט המחוזי בתל אביב מרשיע את הנשיא לשעבר משה קצב באונס ובעבירות מין. אב בית הדין: השופט ג'ורג' קרא, ערבי נוצרי מיפו.
קצב נידון ל 7 שנות מאסר. בהרכב הערעור בעליון ישב השופט סלים ג'ובראן, גם הוא אזרח ערבי. הערעור נדחה פה אחד, ובדצמבר 2011 קצב נכנס לכלא.
ב 2017 קרא מונה לבית המשפט העליון.
מקרה אחד לא מוכיח שוויון: יעד הייצוג של עובדים ערבים בשירות המדינה עומד על 10% בלבד מאז 2008.
זה יכול לקרות אצלכם? כתבו לי.

lines.line: One Arab judge. One former president, sent to prison.
December 30, 2010. Tel Aviv. Israel's former president, Moshe Katsav, hears the verdict.
The judge leading the panel: George Karra. An Arab Christian, born in Jaffa.
The verdict: guilty, of rape and other sexual offences.
The sentence: seven years in prison.
Katsav appeals to the Supreme Court. One of the three justices: Salim Joubran, also an Arab citizen.
November 2011: the appeal is rejected. Unanimously.
December 2011: Israel's former head of state walks into prison.
And Judge Karra? In 2017, he joined Israel's Supreme Court.
No single case proves equality. Israel's civil service target for Arab staff is just ten percent, unchanged since 2008.
Could this happen in your country? Tell me below.
So here's the headline nobody shares.
